method: Worker A is forcibly killed at a persisted checkpoint, after a committed effect, or after invoking an effect before its commit. Worker B is already running before the kill and acquires the expired lease. API task state and persisted Trace are checked after recovery.
command_result: 6 passed in 31.96s (3 existing SQLite crash tests plus 3 new PostgreSQL standby-worker cases)

live_browser_unknown.environment: separate PostgreSQL database evoagent_joint_20260926, Mock API on 127.0.0.1:18002, host Worker subprocesses

observed_defect.description: A deliberately parked file write exceeded the 30-second tool timeout. Task became completed while ToolEffect stayed unknown and no approval existed. This is invalid and motivated the finalization guard.

fixed_case.before_browser: waiting_user, unknown effect, pending approval, one write invocation and existing report.md
fixed_case.after_browser: completed, committed effect, approved decision, one write invocation

timeout_after_write.before_approval: tool_timeout, waiting_user, unknown effect, pending approval, one write invocation
timeout_after_write.observed_resume_defect: Before the approval fix, committed:report.md requeued the task but the checkpoint skipped the failed tool and finalization requested approval again.
timeout_after_write.fixed_resolution: ApprovalService now commits the UNKNOWN ledger entry in the approval transaction. The repeated browser committed:report.md decision completed the task with one write invocation and an approved decision.
timeout_after_write.retry_policy: A failed tool checkpoint cannot safely replay in the same task; retry is rejected and the browser asks the user to cancel and create a new task after confirming the external operation did not commit.
timeout_after_write.rejection_policy: A bare rejection does not establish the external outcome and is rejected by the API; the browser hides Reject for UNKNOWN approvals.

limitations: The active-crash test and joint browser scenario use a deterministic Mock provider, not a live remote model.
The three automated crash cases use an ASGI test client; the separate joint UNKNOWN scenario was resolved through the real browser.
Live-browser COMMITTED no-replay was verified for one controlled file_write effect; other external tools remain outside this sample.
For an already failed tool checkpoint, automatic retry in the same task is unavailable; the user must confirm no external commit, cancel, and create a new task.
